worker_start_help.stdout:
orca-ide orchestration worker-start

Usage: orca-ide orchestration worker-start (--task <task_id> | --spec <text> | --spec-file <path|->) [--keep-open] [--on <saved-environment>] [--worktree <current|selector|new-child|new-top-level>] (--agent <agent> | --terminal <handle>) [--task-title <text>] [--deps <json_array>] [--parent <task_id>] [--model <id>] [--effort <level>] [--name <name>] [--repo <selector>] [--base-branch <ref>] [--display-name <text>] [--comment <text>] [--setup <run|skip|inherit>] [--retry-of <dispatch_id>] [--timeout-ms <n>] [--run <run_id>] [--from <handle>] [--retry-request <id>] [--item <n>] [--json] [--full]

Start one supervised worker on the Run home or a connected Orca server

Options:
  --help                 Show this help message
  --json                 Emit machine-readable JSON
  --pairing-code <code>  Run against a remote Orca server using an orca://pair?... code
  --environment <selector> Run against a saved paired Orca server (id or name), or `local` for this machine's own Orca over ORCA_ENVIRONMENT/ORCA_PAIRING_CODE; terminal handles belong to the server that issued them
  --task
  --spec
  --spec-file <path|->  Read the spec from a file or stdin
  --keep-open            Keep the worker open after it finishes
  --task-title <text>    Concise title for an orchestration task
  --deps
  --parent
  --on
  --worktree <selector>  Worktree selector such as identity:<identity>, id:<repo-id>::<path>, folder:<id> (where the command takes folder workspaces), name:<displayName>, branch:<branch>, issue:<number>, path:<path>, or active/current
  --name <name>          Name for the new worktree or automation
  --repo <selector>      Repo selector such as id:<id>, name:<name>, or path:<path>
  --base-branch <ref>    Base branch/ref to create the worktree from
  --display-name <name>  Override the Orca display name
  --comment <text>       Comment stored in Orca metadata
  --setup run|skip|inherit Setup policy for repo-defined setup hooks
  --agent <id>          Launch a known TUI agent in the first terminal
  --model <id>          Provider model id for a new agent launch
  --effort <level>      Reasoning effort for the selected model
  --terminal <handle>  Runtime-issued terminal handle
  --retry-of
  --timeout-ms <ms>     Maximum wait time before timing out
  --run
  --from
  --retry-request <id>  Reissue an earlier request by its ID; replays its result instead of repeating it
  --item
  --full                 Print the full record Orca returned instead of the concise view
